short: The animal-people’s Law in The Island of Doctor Moreau.
note: A commandment recited by the Beast Folk in H. G. Wells’s 1896 novel The Island of Doctor Moreau, whose Law requires animals transformed by surgery to behave like human beings.

short: A hypothetical lost land in the Indian Ocean.
note: A landmass proposed by zoologist Philip Sclater in 1864 to explain the distribution of lemurs and their relatives across Madagascar and Asia; the name later entered lost-continent literature.

sources.label: Philip Sclater: Some Difficulties in Zoological Distribution
